commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
She lays her own inner sorrow on the evening, and says this.

Dim evening, where day and night run together, you too have lost your brightness, as I have. Tell me, is your mate as hard-hearted as mine? From that lost brightness she imagines it has a mate. “Long may you live” carries a hidden sense: you have hurt me, and you have found no joy yourself.
